em_mrc_write — FILEIO mrc op

• Data kinds: any → any

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.em_mrc_write(volume, *, meta) (to call the implementation directly, import fileio; fileio.em_mrc_write(volume, *, meta); from the registry, opsfileio.get("em_mrc_write"))

Usage

Write 2-D/3-D electron-microscopy data as MRC2014/CCP4 bytes.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

mode 0/1/2/6(int8/int16/float32/uint16)を扱う。meta は voxel_size / origin の x,y,z と、それぞれの単位キー voxel_unit='angstrom' / origin_unit='angstrom' を必須とする。

呼び出し例: em_mrc_write(vol, meta={"voxel_size": [1,1,2], "voxel_unit": "angstrom", "origin": [0,0,0], "origin_unit": "angstrom"})。
